title: The Elegant Art of Italy: Lake Como to Rome
price_note: per person, two sharing, land only
blurb: Lake Como, Venice, Florence, Tuscany and Rome in ten nights, with the guides, most meals and every gratuity included.
pace: Full days with early starts; two nights in every hotel
inclusions:
Grand Hotel Victoria in Menaggio, Hotel Gabrielli in Venice, The St. Regis Florence, Fonteverde in San Casciano dei Bagni and The St. Regis Rome, two nights each
Most meals, with wine at dinner
All gratuities, including the Tauck director and driver
A private boat on Lake Como with a stop in Bellagio and a visit to Villa del Balbianello
High-speed train from Venice to Florence
A lecture by an art historian in Florence before the museum visits
Privately guided visits to the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel, the Uffizi and the Galleria dell'Accademia
Airport transfers on arrival and departure
erics_note:
This is the Tauck itinerary I point couples to when they want Italy done properly once and never want to reach for a wallet on the road. It runs north to south, which is the right direction: the lake first, while you are fresh, and Rome last, when you have the measure of the country. Two nights in every hotel means you unpack five times in ten nights, not eight.

The hotels are the point. The St. Regis in Florence and in Rome, Fonteverde with its thermal pools in the Tuscan hills, a lakeside grand hotel in Menaggio. The art is privately guided, so the Vatican and the Uffizi happen without the queue. Go in May, June or late September; July is hot in Rome.

itinerary.title: Arrive Milan and on to Menaggio on Lake Como
itinerary.text: A transfer from Milan to the Grand Hotel Victoria on the lake. The evening is a welcome dinner with the group.

itinerary.title: A day on fashionable Lake Como
itinerary.text: A private boat across the lake to Bellagio, and a visit to Villa del Balbianello and its terraced gardens. The afternoon is yours on the waterfront.

itinerary.title: A wine-pairing lunch and arrival in Venice
itinerary.text: East across Lombardy and the Veneto with a wine-pairing lunch on the way. Arrive at the Hotel Gabrielli, on the waterfront near St Mark's.

itinerary.title: A day well spent in Venice
itinerary.text: A guided morning in St Mark's and the lanes behind it, then a gondola and a free afternoon.

itinerary.title: By high-speed rail to Renaissance Florence
itinerary.text: The train to Florence in under two and a half hours. An art historian's lecture sets up the next day's museums.

itinerary.title: Treasures of the Uffizi Gallery
itinerary.text: Privately guided visits to the Uffizi and the Galleria dell'Accademia, Michelangelo's David included.

itinerary.title: Through Tuscany via medieval Siena
itinerary.text: South through the Chianti hills with a stop in Siena, then on to Fonteverde, a spa hotel above the Tuscan countryside.

itinerary.title: A taste of the Tuscan countryside
itinerary.text: A day in the hills: a tasting, a village, the thermal pools in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: The treasures of Imperial Rome
itinerary.text: On to Rome and The St. Regis. A guided afternoon among the Forum and the Colosseum.

itinerary.title: Impressive Vatican wonders
itinerary.text: A privately guided visit to the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel. A farewell dinner closes the tour.

itinerary.title: Arrivederci, Roma
itinerary.text: Transfer to the airport, or stay on; I can add nights in Rome or a few days on the Amalfi coast.
